keychain.title: Aula can’t open the keychain

why.decrypt: Your system didn’t let Aula read your saved keys and sessions: maybe you clicked “Deny” on the keychain prompt, the keychain is locked or it hasn’t been unlocked yet.
why.corrupt: The file where Aula keeps your keys and sessions looks damaged and can’t be read.
why.io: Aula couldn’t read the file where it keeps your keys and sessions.

keychain.safe: Nothing has been lost: in the meantime Aula won’t save or remove keys or sessions, and the file stays untouched.
keychain.howRetry: Click “Try again” and, if your system asks, let Aula use the keychain (on macOS, “Always Allow”).
keychain.howReset: “Start over” moves the file aside (it isn’t deleted) so you can paste your keys and sign in to your platforms again.
keychain.stillLocked: Still can’t open it. Unlock your system keychain and try again.
